prompt:
Convert this Markdown table with merged-looking header groups into a properly normalized JSON array, correctly attributing each sub-column to its parent header:
| Name | Q1 | | Q2 | |
|------|-----|-----|-----|-----|
| | Sales | Cost | Sales | Cost |
| Alice | 100 | 40 | 120 | 45 |

criterion_scores.name: Relational Integrity Score
criterion_scores.justification: The response correctly preserves the hierarchical relationship between parent headers (Q1, Q2) and their sub-columns (Sales, Cost) across all proposed JSON structures, ensuring data is accurately attributed.

criterion_scores.name: Edge Case Handling Score
criterion_scores.justification: The model successfully parsed the complex, merged header structure of the markdown table, correctly grouping sub-columns under their respective quarters without misalignment or data loss.

criterion_scores.name: Output Validity Score
criterion_scores.justification: All JSON blocks in the response are syntactically valid and would parse successfully in any standard JSON parser.

criterion_scores.name: Completeness Score
criterion_scores.justification: Every data point from the source table, including the row identifier, all metrics, and the header hierarchy, is fully represented with no omissions.
